maria_support: FYI customer Zetta (acct_zt_99) reported a refund never completed. They got a 400 and the refund endpoint shows no call — our autorouter invoked update_api_key instead. Repro steps below, logs pasted. Can someone take?

alex_eng: can you paste the raw payload and the router decision log?

maria_support: sure — payload we got from the UI (redacted):
```json
{
  \"account\": \"acct_zt_99\",
  \"amount\": 125.00,
  \"currency\": \"USD\",
  \"note\": \"refund for duplicate charge\",
  \"api_key_rotation\": false
}
```
and the router decision snippet (sanitized):
```text
selector.score(issue_refund) = 0.23
selector.score(update_api_key) = 0.81
selector.choice = update_api_key
invoked = update_api_key(args={\"account_id\":\"acct_zt_99\",\"new_key\":null})
```

alex_eng: ugh. looks like the fuzzy matcher overweighted the token "api" in api_key_rotation. update_api_key got picked despite missing new_key.

jenna_sre: is there any auth exposure or API key churn from this? any keys rotated inadvertently?

maria_support: no churn — update_api_key returned 400 because new_key was null. But the user-facing flow got a 400 instead of a refund response, and they retried and caused a duplicate charge. Customer upset.

kevin_prod: two immediate asks: 1) add a schema pre-check before routing so presence of amount/currency strongly favors issue_refund. 2) de-weight boolean flags that contain "api" unless they match the update_api_key signature exactly.

alex_eng: agree. i'll push a hotfix to the selector heuristics: (a) treat exact param name matches as +0.5, (b) substring matches like "api" in unrelated keys get -0.3, (c) require required params to be present to pick a tool. will add unit tests.

deploy-bot: deploy started: selector-hotfix v2026.3.17-1 by alex_eng

oncall_bot: quick scan — number of routed update_api_key calls in last 24h with amount>0 in payload: 3 matches (suspected misroutes).

maria_support: customer was refunded manually and given a credit; they've accepted the apology but asked for root cause and fix. please include timeline.

alex_eng: hotfix pushed and pinned. @maria_support can you re-run the repro when you get a chance?

maria_support: re-run now — autorrouter picks issue_refund with confidence 0.92. payload and logs:
```text
selector.score(issue_refund)=0.92
selector.score(update_api_key)=0.05
invoked=issue_refund(args={amount:125.00,currency:USD})
```

kevin_prod: filing prod ticket PROD-874: "Schema gating + regression for selector fuzzy matches". Assign to alex_eng, ETA EOD. Also add a small dataset to our selector unit tests covering boolean flags, suffixes, and substring traps.

deploy-bot: deploy success: selector-hotfix v2026.3.17-1 :white_check_mark:

oncall_bot: remediation note: throttled rollback not required. postmortem required.

maria_support: thanks all — i'll start the customer communication draft and add timeline entries.

alex_eng: i'll open a short postmortem PR with the logs + testcases.

kevin_prod: add regression to CI gating before selector releases.

maria_support: closing loop with customer, will attach PROD-874 and postmortem when ready.
